0022600086.text: Both the Washington Wizards and Milwaukee Bucks open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Wizards hosting. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), both listed as out, while Milwaukee has no players listed as unavailable. The Wizards won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 109-99 home win over the Bucks on January 29, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Washington a 65% chance to win.
